[ISBK.3.2] **`supported_aggs` validation.** Each backing has a static
upper-bound set of aggregations it may serve. A backend may declare a
**subset**; one declaring a **superset** fails registration, and so engine
construction, with `DS_ERR_BACKEND_BAD_AGGS` ([NSBK.2]). The aggregation
ordinals are `ds_series_agg_kind_t` (`DS_SERIES_AGG_AVG` …
`DS_SERIES_AGG_PERCENTILE`; [NSBK.6.3]).
